ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your career. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between family and relationships. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and routine. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between money and romance. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your image and family. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and money. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your career and your image. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
From {H:1823026183000}, the Moon moves into {S:10} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The square between Mercury and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.
